title: Revealing the dynamic network structure of the Beck Depression Inventory-II
limitations: - Small sample size; - Lack of diversity in sample; - Limited to two therapy groups; - BDI-II may not capture differences between therapies; - No person-specific network analysis due to computational constraints
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code and data availability are not explicitly stated in the paper, but supplementary materials or repositories may exist. The study used a modified multilevel VAR method, which is computationally intensive and may not be fully reproducible without additional resources.
